topic: Copy and Move Semantics for Multiply Inherited Classes
explanation: When a class inherits from multiple base classes, understanding how copy, move, and assignment operations behave is crucial.  The default synthesized versions of these operations (copy constructor, move constructor, copy assignment, move assignment, destructor) will recursively handle the base classes.  However, if you define any of these operations yourself in the derived class, the compiler will *not* automatically handle the base classes; you must explicitly manage them to prevent errors and ensure correct resource management.
